module TopModule (
    input  logic clk,
    input  logic reset,
    input  logic [7:0] d,
    output logic [7:0] q
);

    always_ff @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            q <= 8'b0;
        end else begin
            q <= d;
        end
    end

endmodule
